summary: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp, a Cayman/ Nasdaq-listed SPAC (HCACU/HCAC/HCACR), filed an 8-K reporting that on September 30, 2026 it signed binding PIPE subscription agreements tied to its previously announced May 31, 2026 Business Combination with REEcycle Holdings, Inc. and merger sub HCAC Star Merger Sub. Insiders-affiliated entities controlled by REEcycle director Michael McMullen and advisory-team partners Richard Albarran and Drew Townsend subscribed for 210,000 domesticated HCAC common shares at $10.00 each, grossing $2.1 million, closing only upon the business combination. Cohen & Company Capital Markets is placement agent; the filing discloses no premium, break fee or outside date, leaving redemption levels and any further PIPE as the key risk-arb variables.
